scope: Bounded check of the frozen two-temperature component against recent experimental findings and mechanism proposals. No complete new benchmark validation or model fit.

sources.reading_scope: Publisher-indexed introduction, sections 3a-3b and conclusions read. The existing identified author-copy excerpt supplies the recorded source bytes; it is not an original PDF.
sources.finding: Low relative excess favors compact high-density growth; substantial hollowing and branching increase with relative excess. The approximate transition range 0.2-0.4 spans heterogeneous experiments and is not a universal sharp threshold.
sources.application: Test whether the frozen component contains a humidity response in its morphology and deposition-density closures. Do not impose the empirical range as an exact new numerical acceptance target.

sources.reading_scope: Publisher-indexed experimental methods and sections on mass, basal area and comparison with the 1991 study read. Direct publisher page returned 403; no original PDF or numeric table was acquired.
sources.finding: At maintained water saturation, crystal mass increases with liquid-water content while diameter is largely insensitive. The author also questions water saturation in part of the older warmer planar-crystal experiments.
sources.application: The present deposition-only component has no cloud-droplet-content response. This identifies an omitted experimental dependence, without assigning a quantitative error or changing the historical reference curves.

sources.reading_scope: Abstract, model scope and attachment-kinetics discussion. Individual image panels were not digitized or used as numerical targets.
sources.finding: 206 observations vary temperature and supersaturation with a controlled needle-tip start.
sources.application: Independent morphology evidence remains useful; its seed geometry and observables differ from the tuned freely falling spheroid. No pointwise pass or fail is assigned here.

sources.reading_scope: Published abstract and previously identified indexed methods/limitations; no complete new experimental reconstruction.
sources.application: Measurements at -67 to -46 C lie outside the two fitted temperatures and involve substrate growth. They cannot directly validate or falsify the warm-column and -14.4 C settings.

sources.reading_scope: Experimental methods, section 3.4 and conclusions read in the published HTML.
sources.application: Field growth depends on moisture supply and particle competition. A prescribed-air single-crystal calculation is not the same experiment; population moisture feedback must be evaluated in a coupled calculation. No unsupported direct error is assigned.

sources.reading_scope: Published abstract and archived data description; complete paper equations remain unavailable. This source was already recorded in the earlier hollow-growth investigation.
sources.application: Rim width and step-source location are unresolved in the tuned model. Their omission is a limitation, not by itself proof that an effective bulk law fails every measured history. The warm time-series comparison reuses 1991 observations.

sources.reading_scope: Published abstract and figures description; 2025 preprint data, methods and results sections. The final publisher full text returned 403.
sources.application: Learning mass-dependent growth functions from 290 mass histories does not itself contradict this model, which already depends on size and volume. The study does not jointly establish warm-column dimensions and fall speed. No training or coefficient substitution was performed.
